io.github.anominy.steamid

Class USteamCsgo

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.anominy.steamid.USteamCsgo

  • public final class USteamCsgo
extends Object
    A Steam CS:GO utility.

    USteamCsgo is the utility class to make conversions between a Steam account type-32 identifier and a CS:GO friend code.

    See Also:
    De- and encoding CS:GO friend codes on UnKnoWnCheaTs, go-csgofriendcode by emily33901 on GitHub

    • Method Detail

      • fromXuidOrElse

        @Contract(value="null, _ -> param2",
          pure=true)
public static @UnknownNullability String fromXuidOrElse(@Nullable
                                                                                                                  @Nullable Integer xuid,
                                                                                                                  @Nullable
                                                                                                                  @Nullable String defaultValue)
        Convert a unique Steam account identifier to a interface-friendly CS:GO friend code or return a default value on failure.

        Wraps fromXuidNoCheck(int).

        Possible failure cases:

        • Steam account identifier isn't valid.
        • MD5 message digest algorithm isn't supported.
        
     // (String) defaultValue
     USteamCsgo.fromXuidOrElse(0, <defaultValue>);

     // (String) defaultValue
     USteamCsgo.fromXuidOrElse(Integer.MAX_VALUE, <defaultValue>);

     // (String) "AJJJS-ABAA"
     USteamCsgo.fromXuidOrElse(1, <defaultValue>);

     // (String) "AEVDG-WQTQ"
     USteamCsgo.fromXuidOrElse(1266042636, <defaultValue>);
        Parameters:
        xuid - Steam account identifier to convert, may be null
        defaultValue - default value to return on failure, may be null
        Returns:
        interface-friendly CS:GO friend code or the default value

      • fromXuidOrEmpty

        @NotNull
 @Contract(pure=true)
public static @NotNull String fromXuidOrEmpty(@Nullable
                                                                             @Nullable Integer xuid)
        Convert a unique Steam account identifier to a interface-friendly CS:GO friend code or return an empty string on failure.

        Wraps fromXuidOrElse(Integer, String) w/ UwString.EMPTY as the default value.

        Possible failure cases:

        • Steam account identifier isn't valid.
        • MD5 message digest algorithm isn't supported.
        
     // (String) ""
     USteamCsgo.fromXuidOrEmpty(0);

     // (String) ""
     USteamCsgo.fromXuidOrEmpty(Integer.MAX_VALUE);

     // (String) "AJJJS-ABAA"
     USteamCsgo.fromXuidOrEmpty(1);

     // (String) "AEVDG-WQTQ"
     USteamCsgo.fromXuidOrEmpty(1266042636);
        Parameters:
        xuid - Steam account identifier to convert, may be null
        Returns:
        interface-friendly CS:GO friend code or the empty string

      • toXuidOrElse

        @Contract(value="null, _ -> param2; !null, _ -> !null",
          pure=true)
public static @UnknownNullability Integer toXuidOrElse(@Nullable
                                                                                                                                    @Nullable String code,
                                                                                                                                    @Nullable
                                                                                                                                    @Nullable Integer defaultValue)
        Convert an interface-friendly CS:GO friend code to a unique Steam account identifier or return a default value on failure.

        Wraps toXuidNoCheck(String).

        Possible failure cases:

        • CS:GO friend code is null.
        • CS:GO friend code doesn't match w/ the USteamRegex.CSGO_CODE.
        
     // (Integer) defaultValue
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrElse(null, <defaultValue>);

     // (Integer) defaultValue
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrElse("", <defaultValue>);

     // (Integer) 1
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrElse("AJJJS-ABAA", <defaultValue>);

     // (Integer) 1
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrElse("  AJJJS-ABAA  ", <defaultValue>);

     // (Integer) 1266042636
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrElse("AEVDG-WQTQ", <defaultValue>);
        Parameters:
        code - interface-friendly CS:GO code to convert, may be null
        defaultValue - default value to return on failure, may be null
        Returns:
        Steam unique account identifier or the default value

      • toXuidOrBase

        @Contract(pure=true)
public static int toXuidOrBase(@Nullable
                                                    @Nullable String code)
        Convert an interface-friendly CS:GO friend code to a unique Steam account identifier or return the base value on failure.

        Wraps toXuidOrElse(String, Integer) w/ USteamId.BASE_XUID as the default value.

        Possible failure cases:

        • CS:GO friend code is null.
        • CS:GO friend code doesn't match w/ the USteamRegex.CSGO_CODE.
        
     // (Integer) 0
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrBase(null);

     // (Integer) 0
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrBase("");

     // (Integer) 1
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrBase("AJJJS-ABAA");

     // (Integer) 1
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrBase("  AJJJS-ABAA  ");

     // (Integer) 1266042636
     USteamCsgo.toXuidOrBase("AEVDG-WQTQ");
        Parameters:
        code - interface-friendly CS:GO code to convert, may be null
        Returns:
        Steam unique account identifier or the base value
